label: D1 after a reward, when committed to a2, late in the episode
explanation: Fires almost only at D1 (98% of mass) when the reward input is 1 (previous trial rewarded); never at D2 and rarely at GO. Within rewarded D1 steps it is selective for the a2 side: the agent is about to choose a2 (action == 2 at D1 is the upcoming choice, which the agent computes; policy logit mildly toward a2, choice in [-4.4,-1.5]) and usually the previous choice was a2 too. The observed-only variant (phase == D1) & (in_rew == 1) & (prev_action == 2) & (ep_trial >= 60) gets dev F1 0.70 (P 0.82, R 0.61); I recorded the upcoming-choice version (dev F1 0.76, P 0.74, R 0.79, mass recall 0.82) because it scores better. A strong time-in-episode dependence: firing rate climbs from ~1% before trial 50 to 14% in trials 90-99, matching a low model value (value < 7.5); the rel +1 D1 step holds extra mass. Does not fire on unrewarded D1, on a1-committed trials, or on any step with a nonzero state/action input. Magnitude is largest late in the episode and on rewarded D1 after a2 choices; the threshold on episode time is a coarse stand-in for a graded value/time signal.
